items.literal: Walk slowly and you'll get further.

items.hu: Ajándék lónak ne nézd a fogát!
items.literal: Don't look at the teeth of a gift horse.
items.ro: Calul de dar nu se caută la dinți.

items.hu: Addig üsd a vasat, amíg meleg!
items.literal: Hit the iron while it's hot.
items.meaning: Act while you have the chance.

items.literal: Who dares, wins.
items.meaning: You have to take a risk to win.

items.literal: Many little things go a long way.
items.ro: Picătură cu picătură se face un lac.

items.literal: Who gets up early finds gold.
items.meaning: The early bird catches the worm.
items.ro: Cine se scoală de dimineață departe ajunge.

items.hu: Nem esik messze az alma a fájától.
items.literal: The apple doesn't fall far from its tree.
items.ro: Așchia nu sare departe de trunchi.

items.literal: A dog won't turn into bacon.
items.ro: Lupul își schimbă părul, dar năravul ba.

items.literal: More was lost at Mohács.
items.meaning: It's not the end of the world.

items.literal: The owl tells the sparrow it has a big head.
items.meaning: The pot calling the kettle black.

items.literal: The peppercorn is small but strong.
items.meaning: Small people can be very strong.

items.literal: As many houses, as many customs.
items.meaning: Every family does things its own way.

items.hu: Evés közben jön meg az étvágy.
items.literal: Appetite arrives while you eat.
items.meaning: Once you start, you want more.

items.hu: Jobb ma egy veréb, mint holnap egy túzok.
items.literal: Better a sparrow today than a bustard tomorrow.
items.meaning: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
items.ro: Mai bine o vrabie în mână decât un cioroi pe gard.

items.literal: Even the wall has ears.
As you sow, so you reap.
A bird by its feathers, a person by their friend.
items.meaning: You're known by the company you keep.
items.ro: Spune-mi cu cine te aduni, ca să-ți spun cine ești.

items.literal: Who searches, finds.
Slow water washes away the shore.
Every beginning is hard.
items.meaning: The start is always the hardest part (Hungarian too!).

items.literal: (It's) a dog's problem.
items.meaning: He or she is perfectly fine.

items.literal: Sky and earth.
This is where the dog is buried.
items.meaning: That's the heart of the problem.

items.literal: He lets it into a long broth.
items.meaning: He talks on and on, dragging it out.

items.literal: A raincoat after the rain.
items.ro: După război mulți viteji se arată.

items.literal: It says Thursday.
Hits the nail on its head.
You could spread him on bread.
The rain's leg is hanging.
He doesn't give up anything of '48.
items.meaning: He won't budge on his principles (after the 1848 revolution).

items.literal: We're on one wavelength.
items.ro: Suntem pe aceeași lungime de undă.

items.literal: Not worth a wooden penny.
